source: MLIT National Land Numerical Information N05 Railway Time Series
source_japanese: 国土数値情報 鉄道時系列データ
reason: The source-specific N05 conditions explicitly restrict use to noncommercial purposes. Their linked content terms exclude redistribution of copies for that category. The atlas distributes its database and embeds it in a public downloadable application, so N05 is not an eligible source under those terms without separate permission.

source_pages.relevant_sections: Content; data reference date; source permission conditions
source_pages.finding: Current 2025 edition still labels permission as noncommercial because JTB Publishing reference works were used. Excludes freight-only railway lines and stations.

source_pages.relevant_sections: Article 1; particularly the noncommercial category and inheritance of terms
source_pages.finding: Source-specific permissions apply; the noncommercial category excludes redistribution of copies.

temporal_schema_reference_only.N05_004: Year the section opened for service; 999 means unknown.
temporal_schema_reference_only.N05_005b: Start year for this installation/attribute period; pre-1950 installations are clamped to 1950.
temporal_schema_reference_only.N05_005e: Year before a change or closure; 9999 indicates extant, 999 unknown. A finite value does not alone prove railway closure because attribute changes also end periods.
temporal_schema_reference_only.N05_006: Group identifying the same railway or station across attribute periods.
temporal_schema_reference_only.N05_007: Attribute-change identifier, including multiple changes in the same year.

rejected_processing: Do not bulk import, trace, copy, or redistribute N05 station coordinates or line geometries into the open atlas.
Do not classify every ended attribute period as an abandoned railway.
Do not treat the 1950 lower bound as the actual opening year of older railways.
